explanation: Silver bromide, like silver chloride, darkens in sunlight as it decomposes into silver metal and bromine — the same light-sensitivity black-and-white photographic film is built on.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: A pale cream, almost yellowish solid.
beaker_view.observation: Left in sunlight, the pale cream solid gradually darkens to grey and then black, just like silver chloride under the same light.
